top_signals.title: SK Hynix Shares Fall as Solidigm’s Potential US IPO Sours Mood
top_signals.summary: SK Hynix Inc. shares fell as media reports of a potential listing of the chipmaker’s US subsidiary added to concerns over its complex ownership structure.

top_signals.title: 30% of children in low-income families miss out on extracurriculars: survey
top_signals.summary: Among the low-income households that had reduced spending on extracurricular activities, 76.5% cited the rising prices for necessities as a factor.
